name: FFS_SP_ACTIVITY_GROUP
description: Defines groups of activities to be distributed during a routing run.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Autoincremental unique identifier of the activity group. It is the primary key.

columns.name: ROUTING_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Scheduling plan identifier, the foreign key to the table FFS_SCHEDULING_PLAN.

columns.name: CUSTOM_FILTER_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the table FFS_FILTER.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_LOCATION
columns.description: Describes the 'location' of the activities for the group. It is a relative location like 'bucket' or 'existing route', 'scheduled' or 'non-scheduled' routes.

columns.name: UNACCEPTABLE_OVERDUE
columns.description: Allowed activity overdue, minutes. The field may be negative if a field resource has to come prior the service window end.

columns.name: OVERDUE_COST
columns.description: Late arrival penalty per minute of the overdue.

columns.name: NON_ASSIGNMENT_COST
columns.description: Relative cost of not assigning an activity.

columns.name: SLA_COST_COEFF
columns.description: Coefficient to modify SLA overdue and non-assignment cost for activities with SLA.

columns.name: SLA_OVERDUE_COST
columns.description: Relative cost of activity SLA overdue.

columns.name: SLA_VIOLATION_FACT_COST
columns.description: Relative cost of an activity assignment with SLA-violation.

columns.name: IS_MULTIDAY
columns.description: Flag Shows If The Rescheduling Of Activities From One Day To Another Within Routing Plan Period Is Allowed.

columns.name: AUTOORDERING_TYPE
columns.description: Defines the behaviour of not-ordered activities.

columns.name: SLA_POLICY
columns.description: Defines rules for activities scheduling based on their SLA window.

columns.name: BUNDLING_POLICY
columns.description: Defines scheduling behaviour for activities with the same visit bundling key.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
